substrate_spec.geometry: wafer diameter <= 250 mm (available diameters: D100 / D150 / D200 / D300); thickness >= 300 um (lower bound, not an upper bound)
substrate_spec.convention_note: Legacy documents wrote 'substrate length L <= 250 mm'; this always meant the WAFER DIAMETER, not a rectangular plate length (clarified 2026-09-11).
substrate_spec.naming_note: The substrate is SYNTHETIC FUSED SILICA (amorphous SiO2, flame-hydrolysis grade), NOT generic 'SiO2'. Do not conflate it with thermal oxide (SOI BOX, grown on Si, not a free-standing substrate), crystal quartz (birefringent single crystal), natural fused quartz (metal impurities), CVD oxide (hydrogenated), or display glass (used by SiOG as a thick lower cladding). Reference doc: docs/reports/fabrication/2026-09-11_熔融石英与SiO2术语差别.md

material_route.principle: STAGED PROGRESSION, not a four-way trade-off: Si / Si3N4 / TiO2 / PMMA are not competing candidates to be淘汰; each step solves the failure mode exposed by the previous step and matches the fabrication capability actually available.

start_point.platform: HPFS 7980 fused silica + PECVD a-Si:H deposited directly on glass (no bonding, no layer transfer)
start_point.first_device: metasurface waveguide, starting with a GRATING COUPLER (excitation side) for spatial radiation control (direction, phase/wavefront, amplitude, polarization)
why: cheapest D100 witness coupon (approx. CNY 1250 per piece, [E13])

steps.platform: Si3N4 (PECVD/LPCVD; etch-free or etched sub-routes; DUV for volume)
steps.enables: long propagation length / lower waveguide loss

steps.platform: SOI (SOITEC 220 nm standard) / SiOG (ultra-thin Si film, pre-patternable interface)
steps.enables: single-crystal Si, mature foundry supply chain
fastest process loop closure and low-index final structure (freestanding membrane)

material_route.soi_note: SOI (SOITEC and others) is the most widely used platform in the collected literature and in industry (Q1-12 Taillaert 2006: 200 mm SOI/SOITEC, 220 nm Si / 1 um BOX, DUV 248 nm). Registered as witnessing platform + migration target, NOT the first-round start.

fabrication_philosophies.subtractive: Si, Si3N4 (etched route): resist pattern -> (metal/oxide) hard mask -> dry etch
fabrication_philosophies.additive: TiO2: reverse-tone resist holes -> ALD gap fill -> etchback
fabrication_philosophies.pattern-only: PMMA (and the PMMA sub-route on Si3N4): the patterned resist IS the device

inherited_modules_first_round: etch DOE gate (rate, mask selectivity, CD bias, sidewall angle, residue, roughness)
evidence: E14 (D5 Li 2022, Si Al hard mask)
E15 (T6 Fathi 2026, TiO2 ALD gap fill)
